name: getapp/compare-software
description: Compare two software products side-by-side, including features, pricing, reviews, pros/cons, and support options. slug1 is the full product path, slug2 is the comparison product slug.

slug1.description: Full product URL path for the first product (e.g. 'collaboration-software/a/monday-com').

slug2.description: Product slug for the second product to compare (e.g. 'notion', 'trello'). Obtainable from popular_comparisons in get_software_details.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.
